data.description: A crossbow bolt used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (crit x2). Bolts come in a case or quiver that holds 10 bolts (or 5, for a repeating crossbow).
data.name: Repeating Bolt
